statement: S-Path-RAG uses an iterative Neural-Socratic Graph Dialogue loop where the language model produces concise diagnostic messages that are mapped to targeted graph edits or seed expansions, enabling adaptive retrieval when the model expresses uncertainty.

evidence.quote: The system runs inside an iterative Neural-Socratic Graph Dialogue loop in which concise diagnostic messages produced by the language model are mapped to targeted graph edits or seed expansions, enabling adaptive retrieval when the model expresses uncertainty.
